item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We refuse to accept that future. We demand a halt to its development.

2. We cannot trade a billion human lives for the promise of technological progress. Building superintelligent AI within the next 20 years will cause catastrophe on that scale. We must stop this race before it reaches the finish line.

3. We stand for a future in which humanity survives and thrives. Superintelligent AI built within the next 20 years will kill at least a billion people. We demand that governments prevent its development—not merely prepare for its arrival.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We face a choice that will define humanity’s future. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We will not dress that outcome up as a manageable risk or an acceptable price of progress. We reject the idea that technological ambition outweighs human life. We demand a halt to the development of superintelligent AI, backed by enforceable rules and international cooperation. We have work to do: organise, build public pressure, and make governments act. We can choose a different future, but we must stop the race that leads to this one.
